stemMd: For a disclosure-triggering default to serve its intended purpose, it is especially important that

options.label: A
options.textMd: the other party be unable to take precautions.

options.label: B
options.textMd: the rule remain difficult to discover.

options.label: C
options.textMd: the party expected to disclose notices and understands the rule.

options.label: D
options.textMd: the information be impossible to communicate.

options.label: E
options.textMd: all parties prefer the default after full negotiation.

explanationMd: The third paragraph explains that an unread or misunderstood rule can punish without eliciting information. Notice and comprehension are therefore central to the incentive mechanism, even though they do not alone guarantee success.

distractorRationale.e: The strategy may deliberately induce negotiation away from it.
distractorRationale.b: Obscurity is identified as a limitation.
distractorRationale.d: Communication feasibility is a condition of success.
distractorRationale.a: An inability to respond undermines the benefit of disclosure.
